findings.text: Console command line descriptor stores a short driver name with fixed capacity in the teens plus a numeric minor index and a longer device name with capacity in the low tens alongside a boolean distinguishing user supplied entries from platform supplied entries and a pointer to driver options with an extra braille options pointer present only when accessibility braille console support is enabled.
Braille console option helpers in this configuration perform no observable state change and always report success with the setup helper returning zero.

Printk index entry lookup selects per module storage when a module is supplied under module support and otherwise uses core kernel linker delimited storage then enforces an upper bound on position returning absence when out of range and otherwise the indexed entry.

Index sequential iteration starts with a distinct header token at initial position without advancing and otherwise delegates to the next step which fetches the entry at the current position then advances the position by one.

Index display emits a header line for the start token and skips entries lacking format text while deriving severity and continuation attributes from an explicit level string when present else from the format prefix then renders continuation entries distinctly with a default level marker versus an explicit level marker and finally prints severity location and escaped subsystem prefix and format with surrounding punctuation.
Index sequential operations bind start next show and stop callbacks to the corresponding helpers with stop performing no action.

Module name resolution returns the module name when a module is present and a fixed core kernel name otherwise in module enabled builds while always returning the fixed core name in builds without module support.
Printk index debug files are created on module arrival and removed on module departure with other module states ignored and overall notification handling always reporting success.

Early initialization creates a top level printk debug directory with a nested index directory then arms the module notifier when available and publishes the core kernel index file before reporting success.

Prefix capacity takes values forty eight or thirty two depending on configuration and zero when disabled while message capacity is two thousand forty eight when enabled and zero when disabled and record capacity is one thousand twenty four when enabled and zero when disabled.
Message info flags assign value one to forced console display ignoring log level value two to newline termination and value eight to continuation fragment.
Printer thread wake either signals the console wait queue with ordering guarantees paired against waiter preparation or does nothing depending on configuration.
Console flush capability descriptor holds four booleans distinguishing atomic versus offloaded handling for nonblocking consoles and direct versus offloaded handling for legacy consoles.
Per context printk buffers pair a message sized output area with a record sized scratch area where sizes derive from the corresponding maxima.

Printk message descriptor combines a buffers pointer with output length sequence number and dropped count plus optional execution context holding processor identifier process identifier and short command name when that option is enabled.

In the reduced configuration thread activity indicators are constant false and synchronization ownership query is constant false while system control initialization and deferred console output perform no action.

Nonblocking console emergency tracking uses a process wide atomic counter starting at zero plus per processor nesting counters with a separate early boot counter and a static panic buffer area and a boolean controlling unsafe takeover during panic.

Unsafe state update rereads console state and refuses to clear the unsafe marker after a hostile unsafe takeover then verifies forward progress remains possible before attempting an atomic compare exchange to install the requested unsafe value in a retry loop finally rechecking progress.

Unsafe region entry and exit report ownership and clear the caller buffer on failure while reacquisition spins with processor relaxation until acquisition succeeds and then clears the buffer to indicate no buffer use.

Printer thread wake check returns true when stopping and false during emergency or panic activity otherwise under a read side lock it refreshes the expected sequence from the console when usable and reports whether a valid record exists at that sequence.

Printer thread waits interruptibly for the wake condition then rechecks stopping and emergency states returning on stop or rewaiting during emergency and otherwise emits at most one record per pass under a read side lock when usable tracking backlog and yielding the processor before repeating while backlog remains.
Interrupt work handler derives its console from the work item and wakes the associated printer thread.

Device level acquisition forbids migration and initializes a zeroed normal priority context before attempting acquisition followed by unsafe entry while release exits unsafe and drops ownership then under a read side lock flushes pending records when the console remains usable and offload is unavailable preferring atomic flush then legacy direct lock cycle then deferred output.

Braille context reports true only when its console exists and carries the braille flag while braille acquisition initializes a zeroed context with panic priority on panic processor else normal priority and retries with permitted unsafe takeover when panic acquisition initially fails and release simply drops ownership.
Console log level table exports four integers in order for current console level default message level minimum console level and default console level seeded from standard defaults.

Legacy console semaphore acquisition and release wrap the underlying operations with printk safe interrupt state handling and record dependency map acquisition on success and release on unlock with failed try acquisition reporting a nonzero status.

Console registration uses a dedicated mutex and syslog access uses a separate dedicated mutex with a static lock dependency descriptor named for the console lock plus a static integer tracking legacy lock nesting.

Device message logging mode accepts three textual settings for enabled disabled and rate limited behavior with command line setup warning on invalid input synchronizing a display string and permanently locking further changes while the system control path rejects writes when locked and restores prior mode and display string when input is unknown or has trailing characters.
Device message control uses bit positions zero one and two for on off and lock with corresponding single bit masks and a default mask of zero.
Command line console table holds eight entries with preferred index initialized to negative one.
Console message format uses value zero for default rendering and low bit set for syslog style rendering with current format initialized to default.
Global booleans record presence of legacy nonblocking and boot consoles plus whether legacy panic synchronization is allowed and whether console interrupt work is blocked.
Syslog reading tracks a sixty four bit sequence with a partial byte offset and a boolean controlling timestamp inclusion.

Latched sequence holder pairs a sequence latch with two copies of a sixty four bit value initialized to zero and updated by writing the first copy between latch begin and middle steps then the second copy before latch end.

Log level occupies the low three bits and facility occupies the next eight bits while buffer alignment follows pointer width and default buffer length derives from a configured shift with an absolute maximum of two to the thirty first power and an average record length hint of five bits.

Log storage defaults to a static buffer and shift derived length with accessors returning the current base pointer and length and the active ringbuffer pointer initially selecting the static instance alongside a separate dynamic instance and a read only after init flag for per processor data readiness.
Log taking allows at most four parts per operation with a fixed marker indicating truncation.

Observed entry points include early printk index setup command line device message setup system control device message level handling log buffer address and length queries and read side lock held query plus nonblocking console proceed unsafe interrupt work device and braille operations.

Clearing unsafe state after hostile takeover is forbidden and printer threads are suppressed during emergency and panic to favor direct display and reduce mid message takeover while buffer pointers are invalidated on failed unsafe transitions to prevent use after loss of ownership.
Read side lock held query delegates to the underlying sleepable read copy update held check for the console domain.
Global integers control printk suppression oops progress console scheduling ability and lock warning suppression with oops and scheduling related values starting at zero.
Full configuration tracks printer thread activity with a mutable global boolean distinct from the reduced configuration constant false indicators.
Log prefix handling prepends the module name and separator to supplied formats and trace point creation is enabled in this translation unit.
